kypExtensions.summary: The 2×2 column decoder and the three-faces reading: LR+ divides the test-POSITIVE column (TP rate ÷ FP rate) and LR– the test-NEGATIVE column (FN rate ÷ TN rate) — the sign of the ratio selects the column, the disease rows supply numerator (with disorder) and denominator (without disorder); each printed equation's three fractions are three faces of one number (definition form = what it MEANS, sensitivity/specificity form = how to COMPUTE from the classic pair, 2×2 rate form = how to COMPUTE from the grid); plus the mirror rule (the '1 –' sits in the DENOMINATOR for LR+ and the NUMERATOR for LR– — the intact statistic names the quality an extreme value certifies) and the LR = 1 no-shift midpoint.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the three equivalent forms but never states the column rule, the face-to-purpose mapping, the mirror rule, or the LR = 1 reading; the decoder is KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea MOVES 1-2 + mechanisms[0] lr-fraction-map + blocks[2] the decoder list block + the registry visual's fraction cards and number line

kypExtensions.summary: The odds-chain machinery around the two printed clauses: the UNPRINTED probability-to-odds hinge (pretest odds = p/(1–p)) and its mirror the printed back-conversion (odds/(odds + 1)); the five-move protocol (fix the prior → convert to odds → select the LR matching the observed result → multiply → convert back); the worked example carried everywhere (20% prior → odds 0.25 → × LR+ 10 → odds 2.5 → ≈ 71% · × LR– 0.1 → odds 0.025 → ≈ 2.4%); sequential-test chaining (pretest odds × LR₁ × LR₂ = posttest odds) and the Fagan nomogram (named, not drawn) — every worked number and unprinted conversion flagged as KYP.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints 'Pretest odds × LR = posttest odds' and the back-conversion only; the p/(1–p) hinge, the protocol order, all worked numbers, the chaining rule, and the nomogram are KYP's.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea MOVE 3 + mechanisms[1] pretest-to-posttest-map + blocks[3] the steps block + the registry visual's Zone C calculation rail + recall[4-6]

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed block — 4 patterns (LR from sens/spec with the complementary flip; LR from the 2×2 rates; the full chain computation; the threshold attribution), 4 traps (the LR+/LR– formula mirror; odds vs probability; the counterintuitive LR+ > 10 = highly SPECIFIC pairing; LR+ = TP rate/FP rate vs PPV = TP/(TP+FP) column-vs-row), 3 pivots (the two-question direction router; the threshold attribution test; the which-column sign router), and the PE miniCase (5 options, exactly 1 correct: pretest 20% + D-dimer LR– 0.1 → posttest ≈ 2.4% and stop; distractors = the swapped specificity/sensitivity attribution, the halve-the-percentage error, the no-update/prevalence error, and the demands-the-components error, each with why-wrong).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the formulas and rules only; every vignette, distractor design, and question shape is KYP's design.
